constraints.description: The embedded client consumes the named entity.change event, validates the server payload, maps canonical entity types, and ignores transport or malformed events without poisoning the subscription.

validation.validation_method: Focused FakeEventSource unit tests with valid and malformed controls

constraints.description: A detected error closes the failed source before one capped replacement, resets on open, delivers each received post-reconnect event once, and leaves no retry after unsubscribe.

validation.validation_method: Fake-timer unit controls plus one fresh-process Chromium scenario bound to the application EventSource

constraints.description: Existing-ID normalized entity updates rerender through the upstream React hooks; UAR does not patch the Knowledge UI with refresh, replay, or direct store mutation.

validation.validation_method: Upstream before/after hook tests, reviewed upstream commits, and the visible UAR browser transition

constraints.description: The BDD preparation path admits the UAR pnpm version and builds entity-graph-core before the React source declarations instead of consuming stale dist output.

validation.validation_method: Observed pnpm-engine/direct-leaf failures followed by compatibility Cucumber, Turbo dependency build, and final BDD preparation passes

constraints.description: Evidence binds the source hashes and submodule pin, reports every observed command result including unrelated full-suite failures, excludes parent/operator files, and makes no checkpoint-replay or publication claim.

validation.validation_method: Hash/pin replay, strict OpenSpec, artifact schemas/references/state/history, scope audit, diff check, and independent artifact review

global_rules: Use the child OpenSpec proposal, delta, tasks, and KBD scope as acceptance authority.
Do not claim events emitted while disconnected are replayed or delivered losslessly.
Do not treat a source-package defect with a UAR screen refresh or store bypass.
Keep pnpm-lock.yaml, frontend/package.json, settings, static build output, parent certification artifacts, and unrelated KBD churn outside the child commit.
Keep the tested upstream source head and separate generated rc.2 version head distinct; neither PR is an npm publication.
termination_conditions: Strict OpenSpec, artifact schemas/references/checkpoints/history, final source hashes, submodule pin, scoped diff, and git diff checks pass.
Independent history-free artifact critic and judge find no implementation or evidence blocker.
